name: FORTY-ONE EXCHANGE
description: Forty-One Exchange (often known simply as '41' in Southeast Asia and Indonesia) is a high-speed draw-and-discard game centered on set collection. Unlike most card games where high cards are balanced by low ones, every player in 41 is chasing the exact same perfection: a hand of four cards of the same suit that totals exactly 41 points. It is a game of probability and speed, where players must quickly pivot their strategy as the cards they need are snatched up by opponents.

content.text: Forty-One Exchange (often known simply as '41' in Southeast Asia and Indonesia) is a high-speed draw-and-discard game centered on set collection. Unlike most card games where high cards are balanced by low ones, every player in 41 is chasing the exact same perfection: a hand of four cards of the same suit that totals exactly 41 points. It is a game of probability and speed, where players must quickly pivot their strategy as the cards they need are snatched up by opponents.

While its exact origins are undocumented, Forty-One Exchange is a staple of Indonesian social culture (known locally as 'Main Kartu 41'). it is primarily played in informal settings like schools, community centers, and local cafes as a fast-paced gambling or social game.
Each player is dealt 4 cards. The remaining deck is placed in the center as a draw pile.
